blocks.text: Vice Ganda, Mon Confiado, Michael V., Nadine Lustre and more Filipino actors and shows are set to represent the country at the 2026 Asian Academy Creative Awards after clinching national wins in different categories. Vice Ganda earned the Best Actor in a Leading Role honor for her role in “Call Me Mother,” while Confiado earned the Best Actor in a Supporting Role accolade for his performance in “Salvageland.” Michael V. won the Best Actor/Actress in a Comedy Role for “Pepito Manaloto: The Story Continues.” Lustre, for her part, earned the Best Actress in a Leading Role award for her portrayal in […]...
